_meta.purpose: Next-phase promotion gates for the full CedarFix AI system. These gates gate the KB, router, and training pipeline together — not just the classifier model. Pass all REQUIRED gates before any production deployment or major version bump.

P-01.name: vocab_version_minimum
P-01.description: Production arabizi_vocabulary.json must be v14 or later (6340+ terms, 0 CRITICAL violations).
P-01.current_status: PASS — production arabizi_vocabulary.json is v14.0.0 (6340 term_metadata entries, 463 issue_type_keyword variants across 8 sectors); promoted in commit 204db883
P-01.fail_action: BLOCK — promote vocab v14 before any finetuning run or production deployment

P-02.name: training_manifest_exists
P-02.description: A finetuning_manifest_v1.json must exist, listing all training files with row counts and split roles.
P-02.check: data/training/finetuning_manifest_v1.json must exist and list train/val/test/telecom_eval_locked
P-02.fail_action: BLOCK — without a manifest, finetuning runs are not reproducible

P-03.name: zero_train_eval_overlap
P-03.description: No exact text overlap between training data and any locked eval file.
P-03.check: MD5 hash comparison: train vs val, train vs test_locked, train vs telecom_eval_locked
P-03.current_status: PASS — verified 2026-05-31 (0 overlaps across all pairs)
P-03.fail_action: BLOCK — eval contamination makes all accuracy numbers invalid

P-04.name: telecom_locked_eval_exists
P-04.description: A locked 150-case TELECOM eval slice must exist with stratified issue_type coverage and 0 train overlap.
P-04.current_status: PASS — 150 rows, stratified, seed=42, 0 train overlap (created 2026-05-31)
P-04.fail_action: BLOCK — TELECOM accuracy claims require a held-out evidence base

P-05.name: routing_kb_validates
P-05.description: scripts/validate_routing_kb.py must report OK (no ERRORS, only expected WARNING on cross-taxonomy gate scopes).
P-05.fail_action: BLOCK — broken routing KB will cause silent mismatch between model output and routing table

P-06.name: full_accuracy_audit_clean
P-06.current_status: PASS — 0 errors, 0 warnings, 5/5 smoke tests pass (2026-05-31)
P-06.fail_action: BLOCK — audit failures indicate KB/router inconsistencies

P-07.name: hard_benchmark_breadth
P-07.description: The hard-negative eval benchmark must have >= 300 cases across at least 5 sectors, with airport/travel < 30% of cases.
P-07.current_status: PASS — 304 cases, 9 sectors (ELECTRICITY=49, ROADS=47, WATER=42, SAFETY=37, OTHER=33, TELECOM=31, WASTE=28, ENVIRONMENT=24, ADMIN=13); 120/304 HITL; arabizi=263/english=29/arabic=12; airport/travel=0% (2026-05-31)
P-07.fail_action: BLOCK — a hard benchmark dominated by one category cannot support general robustness claims

P-08.name: entity_contact_schema_complete
P-08.description: All 18 entities in public_entities_extended.csv must have all 8 contact fields filled (no empty values).
P-08.check: run: python scripts/_screenshot_audit.py — all 18 must show missing=NONE
P-08.fail_action: BLOCK — incomplete contact data causes citizen-facing routing errors

P-09.name: iep3_vs_router_gap_documented
P-09.description: The gap between IEP3 (uses sector_agency_map.csv) and the municipality-aware router (src/route_complaint.py) is documented and a migration plan exists.
P-09.check: IEP3 upgrade plan must be documented or IEP3 must use route_complaint.py
P-09.current_status: FAIL — IEP3 still uses sector_agency_map.csv; no migration plan committed
P-09.fail_action: WARN — CedarFix accuracy claims apply to route_complaint.py only, not to IEP3

P-10.name: arabic_script_coverage
P-10.description: Training set must have >= 500 Arabic-script rows OR the model explicitly claims Arabizi-only support.
P-10.current_status: WARN — current train: 0 Arabic-script rows; model must be declared Arabizi-only
P-10.fail_action: WARN — document Arabic-only limitation in all user-facing materials
